headline: Knee-to-waist and clean — log it if you're already there.
today: Small short-period S at a fair angle, but the wind cooperates: cross-off and light 5-8mph all day, so it's clean if minimal. Nothing to make the 3hr haul for. If you're local, the log on the morning to midday tide is your move before the afternoon slacks off.

daysToWatch.note: Onshore SW building to 19-21mph — blown out. Skip.
Biggest reading of the week (up to 5ft) but short-period SSW with 12-18mph cross wind — messy and hard to trust. Not worth the drive.
